title: TAMI: Temporally Aligned, Missingness-Aware, and Interpretable Multimodal Fusion for Mental Health Assessment in Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
abstract: arXiv:2608.30857v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Depression and anxiety in older adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) are frequently underdiagnosed due to limited access to care. Multimodal analysis of remote clinical interviews is a scalable screening approach, but existing methods have three limitations. First, they do not correct temporal misalignment across multimodal features extracted at different resolutions, inducing spurious cross-modal associations. Second, remote recordings exhibit uneven modality dropout, but missing values are often zero-filled, making them indistinguishable from valid near-zero measurements. Finally, they do not jointly attribute predictions to modalities, questions, and interview moments, limiting fine-grained clinical interpretation. We propose a Temporally-Aligned, Missingness-Aware, Interpretable (TAMI) multimodal fusion framework. translated_title: TAMI：面向轻度认知障碍老年人心理健康评估的时间对齐、缺失感知且可解释的多模态融合框架
translated_abstract: 患有轻度认知障碍（MCI）的老年人的抑郁和焦虑症状由于医疗资源获取受限而经常被漏诊。对远程临床访谈进行多模态分析是一种可扩展的筛查方法，但现有方法存在三个局限。首先，它们没有校正以不同分辨率提取的多模态特征之间的时间错位，从而引入虚假的跨模态关联。其次，远程录制存在不均匀的模态缺失，但缺失值通常被零填充，导致其无法与有效的近零测量值区分开来。最后，它们无法将预测同时归因于模态、问题和访谈时刻，限制了细粒度的临床解释。我们提出了一个时间对齐、缺失感知、可解释（TAMI）的多模态融合框架。TAMI在问答片段内的共享时间轴上对齐语音、语言、面部和生理特征……
tldr: 提出TAMI多模态融合框架，通过时间对齐、缺失感知和可解释性设计，利用远程临床访谈对轻度认知障碍老年人的抑郁和焦虑进行细粒度、可临床解读的筛查。
en_tdlr: TAMI is a temporally aligned, missingness-aware, and interpretable multimodal fusion framework that enables fine-grained, clinically interpretable screening of depression and anxiety in older adults with MCI through remote clinical interviews.
